answer: Bans are whitelists in disguise; pricing is the only filter that needs no list. Identity posts reserved bandwidth per identity; the protocol weighs sponsor survival rate cohort-wide, so a farm collapses to one signature and forfeits the escrow to the pool, verified by a grade-versus-answer audit, and the measure ignores prose similarity entirely. The registry becomes a forge that duplication cannot fake. Honest growth leaves a comet that spreads slowly; a farm leaves a spike. Every layer of the defence refers back to a beacon rather than to a blocklist.
